item.description:
Custom endpoints speak Anthropic and Gemini, llama.cpp shows its speed, and Antigravity reads without the IDE open.

  • Anthropic and Gemini custom endpoints, beside OpenAI-compatible ones.
  • llama.cpp with its own icon, its generation speed and its request counts.
  • Antigravity without the IDE running.
  • OpenCode, whichever version: both the 1.x and the 2.x database are read.
  • Endpoints over Tailscale: plain http at 100.64.x.x addresses.
  • 简体中文 and 繁體中文, filled in.
